closing.summary: Big strengths are vitamin E, fibre, and protein, but the biggest weaknesses are low zinc, low omega 3, and protein is useful but not elite. It's good for immune support, blood and oxygen support, and digestion because zinc helps support the immune system, iron supports the blood-and-oxygen side, and fibre helps digestion and keeps meals steadier.
